governance.current_identity: 足球项目_CURRENT_唯一正式规则_V5.2.0_PIT数据优先与尾部闭合统一晋级版.docx

estimand: Can a discrete-time generative match simulator using chronologically prior event-sequence latents plus a current starting-lineup snapshot and prior player contribution state improve the full 90-minute score distribution over a frozen rolling-xG independent-Poisson baseline?

new_information: current starting-XI snapshot extracted from lineup data only
player contribution state estimated from prior completed matches only
family_relation.forbidden: No V0 test-190 metric, threshold, residual, fixture outcome, or per-match error may be used to tune V1.

source_schema_inspection.purpose: Freeze exact StatsBomb field mapping and implementation constants, not choose parameters from outcome performance.
source_schema_inspection.note: The official match metadata source co-locates fixture metadata and final score fields. V1 code intentionally does not parse home_score/away_score; evaluation labels are derived only from event streams opened after all same-date predictions are frozen.

label_boundary.same_day_policy: all fixtures on a calendar date are predicted before any event outcomes from that date update history
label_boundary.lineup_snapshot_fields_allowed: only a position record with from=00:00 and start_reason=Starting XI; cards, substitution times, end_reason and later tactical shifts are ignored
label_boundary.event_coverage_preflight: HTTP HEAD only before target event streams are opened

split.folding: chronological match-date groups split into three contiguous folds with no date split across folds

candidate.name: event_player_tactical_discrete_hazard_world_model_v1

event_mapping.final_third_completed_pass: pass outcome is null and end_x >= 80
event_mapping.penalty_box_completed_pass: pass outcome is null and end_x >= 102 and 18 <= end_y <= 62
event_mapping.set_piece_xg: Shot play_pattern contains Corner or Free Kick
event_mapping.goal_bins: Shot outcome Goal plus own-goal event handling; five-minute bin capped at segment 17

lineup_latents: starting-XI continuity versus prior start XI
unknown-starter share from prior team history
role-shape change versus prior starting XI
candidate.lineup_continuity: starter set overlap with prior starting XI divided by 11; fallback 0.5 if no prior lineup
candidate.role_shift: absolute defender/attacker count change versus prior XI divided by 3
candidate.hazard_model: single symmetric Poisson log-link residual hazard model with baseline log(lambda/18) plus temporal-profile offset
dynamic_state: current simulated score difference clipped to [-2,2] and divided by 2

fit.method: IRLS ridge Poisson regression implemented in numpy

development_gate.reason_scientific_component_pass_disallo: Historical availability/provable_available_at for the open event and lineup feed is not established.

post_result_policy.if_fail: freeze result; do not retune on this test set
post_result_policy.if_pass: freeze result; no automatic confirmation, B05 opening, formal promotion, merge, or formal-weight change
